method: Native application UI, local HTTP PDF files, visual observations and accessibility state. Playback screenshots appeared in the chat; no native screenshots are archived here. These are manual observations, not an automated viewer test suite.

Clicked forward play: control changed to pause and a grape fell below the bunch.
Clicked forward play: poster and play icon remained unchanged.

limitations: Chrome's normal profile initially showed a blank about:srcdoc surface; Incognito exposed the built-in PDF viewer. Cause was not established; no extension or security settings were changed.
Viewer frame rate was not measured. Eight frames per second is the requested timer cadence, not a performance result.
The form control accumulates typed command letters in Chrome and Edge; commands still work.
Final packaging adjusted PDF headers and OCG instructions and the untested 3D camera. The captured frames and tested playback algorithms were unchanged.
All other sample-viewer pairs are untested, including native 3D activation and embedded-video playback.
